project.name: AtlasA0
project.description: A0 print-ready and GIS-ready maps of Pakistan (country, provinces, districts, cities) from OpenStreetMap, as PNG and georeferenced GeoTIFF.

usage.notice: This code is not for sale.
usage.notice_in_files: Every source and document file carries the author, email and 'This code is not for sale' notice. JSON files carry it as author / email / license fields. Keep the notice when copying files.
usage.official_use_caveat: Boundaries and features come from OpenStreetMap. Check them against Survey of Pakistan data before official or legal use.
usage.commercial_use: not allowed without a separate written licence from the author (yameenimaad@gmail.com)
usage.noncommercial_use: allowed: personal, educational, research, charity and government use, as the licence states

data_sources.name: OpenStreetMap
data_sources.used_for: roads, water, land use, buildings, boundaries, points of interest
data_sources.credit_on_maps: printed automatically by the 'credit' element (on by default)

data_sources.name: Esri World Imagery
data_sources.note: Follow Esri's terms of use for printed or published imagery.

data_sources.name: OpenTopoMap
data_sources.credit_on_maps: printed automatically on topo maps, next to the OpenStreetMap credit

privacy_and_network.sent_to_servers: place names and map areas being requested only; never your layer files, settings or outputs
privacy_and_network.fair_use: OpenStreetMap services are free and shared. Large batches (e.g. every district of a province) send many requests; the cache avoids repeating them. Do not run several big batches at once.

local_files.content: maps and receptor exports you asked for

local_files.path: cache/ inside the AtlasA0 folder (next to run_gui.py), or $ATLASA0_CACHE; if that folder is read-only: the user cache folder (Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%/AtlasA0/cache, macOS ~/Library/Caches/AtlasA0, Linux ~/.cache/atlasa0)
local_files.content: OpenStreetMap download cache; safe to delete
GUI choices (saved when you press Run or Save settings)
real file and download sizes, used for estimates; safe to delete
where the installed Windows app (AtlasA0.exe) keeps maps and the OSM cache, unless ATLASA0_OUTDIR / ATLASA0_CACHE are set

inputs_read.handling: Read only, never uploaded, never executed. Batch JSON is data, not code. Only open files from people you trust.

output_rules.custom_file_names: Templates may only use {region} {level} {type} {province} {dpi} {date}. Path separators and characters Windows forbids are removed, so files stay in the output folder.
output_rules.overwrite_protection: A template that would give several maps the same name is rejected before any download.
output_rules.geotiff: Map area only, georeferenced in UTM (country map: EPSG:32642). Legend, scale, north arrow and grid are left out unless tiff_furniture is set.
output_rules.paper_sizes: dpi is the real print resolution on the chosen paper; the file has paper size x dpi pixels. Fonts and line widths are scaled with the paper, so A4 text is smaller than A0 text.

limits.sheet: A0 (841 x 1189 mm) by default; A1-A4 or a custom size in mm (100-3000 per side); portrait / landscape / auto

security.disclosure: Keep details private until a fix is released or 90 days have passed, whichever comes first.
security.credit: Reporters are credited if they want to be.

contributions.how: Open an issue or email the author before large changes.
requirements: keep the author / not-for-sale notice in every file
